# Host profile: Google Antigravity

> Generated by `scripts/build.mjs` from `adapters/antigravity/platform.json`. Do not edit.
> Verification: **docs-only** (checked against the documentation, never run live by FORGE).

The rest of FORGE names capabilities, not tools. This page maps each one to this host. Use the native form for a `supported` capability.
For an `unsupported` one, use the fallback. Try an `unverified` one once, and if it fails, use the fallback and say so in the report. Never claim a capability this page doesn't list as supported.

**Models:** standard tier = `inherit`, strong tier = `inherit`.

| Capability | Status | On this host |
|---|---|---|
| entryCommand | supported | the `/forge` skill in the App and CLI; in the IDE, the legacy `/forge` workflow, because skills are not documented as slash-invocable there |
| requestArguments | unverified | Fallback: treat the message that invoked `/forge` as the request |
| skillDir | unverified | Fallback: the folder of the forge SKILL.md you loaded: `.agents/skills/forge/` in the workspace, else `~/.gemini/config/skills/forge/` |
| subagents | supported | `invoke_subagent` with the agent's name (App and CLI). The IDE does not document custom subagents, so use Mode B there |
| parallelSubagents | supported | several `invoke_subagent` calls in one step (App and CLI) |
| foregroundWait | unverified | Fallback: wait for every subagent's result and every long command before ending the turn; never end it with work pending |
| continueSubagent | unverified | Fallback: launch a fresh verifier with its previous report and only the delta |
| perCallModel | unsupported | agent frontmatter accepts `model: inherit \| flash \| pro`, not a model per delegation. Fallback: every agent runs on the session model; record a model escalation as unavailable in the report |
| toolRestriction | unsupported | Fallback: `tools` is omitted because tool names differ and an unknown one can hang the agent; read-only roles follow their instructions, and the host's permission rules still apply |
| gitGuardHook | unsupported | Fallback: the no-commit rules are instructions only; recommend a host deny rule such as `command(regex:git (commit\|push\|merge\|rebase))` (docs/security.md) |
| preApprovedScripts | unsupported | Fallback: the host's command rules decide; if prompts slow the run, ask the user to allow `node <FORGE_HOME>/scripts/*` |
| userQuestion | supported | ask in chat and wait for the reply |
| deferredTools | unverified | Fallback: call MCP tools directly by name |
| browserTools | supported | the built-in browser subagent, plus MCP servers from `~/.gemini/config/mcp_config.json` or `.agents/mcp_config.json` |
| backgroundCommands | unverified | Fallback: run long suites in the foreground |

**Required configuration:**
- Install with `scripts/install.sh --target antigravity` (or `install.ps1 -Target antigravity`) into `~/.gemini/config/` or `<project>/.agents/`.
- Optional, for Playwright and DevTools: MCP servers in `mcp_config.json` (docs/installation.md).

**Limitations:**
- Never exercised live by FORGE: the formats are checked against the documentation only (docs/testing.md has the manual procedure).
- No enforced tool allow-lists, git guard or pre-approved scripts: the rules are instructions, backed by the host's own permission system.
- Every agent inherits the session model, so the standard/strong split and model escalation do not apply.
- The IDE does not document custom subagents or skill slash commands: FORGE uses Mode B and the legacy workflow there.
